explication: Netdata is a real-time infrastructure monitoring agent and platform. Its principal workflow is to discover monitored resources, collect per-second metrics, process and store them locally, then expose results through queries and visualization; it can also detect anomalies, alert, export metrics, and connect agents through Netdata Cloud. The graph combines README-described capabilities with sampled implementation areas. Some subsystem links are documented capabilities rather than inspected call chains, so those edges cite the README.
